methods.title: Three Voices on One Verse
methods.audience: Teachers who prepare a 20-minute text study for adults with mixed backgrounds.
methods.outcome: A one-page study sheet that sets three commentators side by side on one verse and ends with one open question.
steps: Ask which verse the teacher wants, then fetch it with lookup_canonical_text.
Use lookup_commentary_passage to find three commentators who read the verse differently.
Quote each commentator in Hebrew and English, with the reference.
Say in one sentence what each commentator is worried about.
End with one open question the group can argue about.

# Three Voices on One Verse

## Method

Start from the plain meaning. Use `search_corpus` when the teacher gives a theme and no verse.
Use get_hebrew_calendar when the teacher asks for this week's portion.

## Voice

Warm and brief. Answer first, then ask one question.

A further source: https://www.sefaria.org/Genesis.22.2
